idea-plugin.name: Industrial Graphite
idea-plugin.description:
Industrial Graphite — warm graphite dark theme for Java & Spring. 90% calm flat graphite, 10% signal amber, copper and status lamps.

  • UI theme for the New UI and a matching editor color scheme (Java, XML, YAML, SQL, Spring Boot console logs).
  • Industrial icon set: class, abstract class, interface, enum, record, annotation, exception, test class, Java / XML / YAML / PostgreSQL file icons, private / static / final markers.
  • Resource icons: source / test / resources / test resources / excluded roots, modules, packages, static, templates, db/migration, i18n, config folders; properties, Spring profiles, JSON, HTML, CSS, JS, images, .env, Flyway migrations, logback, text.
  • Spring-aware: @Configuration / @SpringBootApplication get the Spring icon, Spring beans (@Component, @Service, @Repository, @Controller, Spring Data repositories) get a bean badge.
  • System icons: run / debug / build actions, debugger steps, breakpoints, VCS, Maven, database nodes, Markdown, tool window icons (20 px and compact 16 px).
  • Spring Boot config files: application / bootstrap, dev / test / prod profiles (YAML and properties).
  • Spring Modulith: application / open / shared modules, exposed / internal packages and named interfaces in the project tree; module gutter, tool window and action icons.
  • Gutter icons: run / tests, inheritance, recursion, lambdas, bookmarks, breakpoints, execution point; Spring, JPA and Database gutter and node icons in IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate.

Recommended font: the theme is designed for IBM Plex Mono. Install it and select it in Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance (UI font) and Settings | Editor | Font.
